subject: Use of Type in defining constants

messages.author: 5f950c9713997d19
messages.subject: Use of Type in defining constants
parts:
For a while, I have explicitly cast constants as Type, for instance Type(5.0), in equations as per the TMB manual. The other day, by mistake I didn't use Type and just entered the constant itself. The program ran as expected. That led me to look through the TMB documentation examples to see how constants were being cast. I found cases where some were and some weren't. I did note that Type casting of constants is recommended in the TMB manual but why? Is there are performance or other cost for not Type casting constants one way or another?

Bob

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: Use of Type in defining constants
parts: If it works without cast there's no reason to cast.
"I did note that Type casting of constants is recommended in the TMB manual but why?"
Because it's easier to tell a user to always cast than to explain when exactly it works without cast.
"Is there are performance or other cost for not Type casting constants one way or another?"
